name: Peggy Deagle
source: A physics professor at Lind Academy, Peggy is dedicated to her students and involved in both academics and athletics. Every day, Professor Deagle faces the usual challenges of teaching with steady patience and care. Together with her wife Shannon, she has built a life rooted in the quiet town of Lind. But the life Peggy has found in Lind is about to unravel as vampires set their sights on the town, including the academy and her students.
